title: Crazy Eights
description: Crazy Eights for two to four people and one phone. Seven cards each, one turned up, and you match the discard by rank or by suit — or drop an eight as a wild and name the suit everybody has to follow. Your hand is only yours: a cover names whoever should be holding the phone and lifts on a tap, then closes itself the moment you play, so the phone is never left sitting on somebody's cards. Illegal cards are dimmed rather than punished, so a wrong tap is impossible. First to empty a hand wins the round and everybody else eats what they are still holding — fifty for an eight, ten for a court. Lowest score when someone crosses the target takes the game.
